headline: Gədəbəy: Mountain district with high nature index and low paved road share.

tags.reason: The nature index is 80 out of 100, national median 51, with 16.2% forest cover.
Listings sample size is 2, with no price data available in the dataset.

summary: Gədəbəy is a mountain district with a population of 101,400 and a density of 82 people per km². The area features 7.99 schools per 10,000 residents, compared to the national median of 4.14. The infrastructure index is 27 out of 100, while the national median is 45. OSM coverage is high, but price data is completely absent from the dataset.
strengths: Nature index is high at 80, compared to the national median of 51 (tebiet index 80; median 51).
School density is higher than the national median with 7.99 per 10,000 residents, compared to 4.14 (7.99 schools per 10,000 residents; median 4.14).
Healthcare index is 76, which exceeds the national median of 49 (sehiyye index 76; median 49).
weaknesses: Paved roads make up only 50% of roads with known surface, though the surface is unknown for 59% of roads (paved share 50%; unknown 59%).
Transport index is low at 53, with 0 bus routes and 0.69 bus stops per 10,000 residents (neqliyyat index 53; median 47).
Kindergarten density is low at 0.59 per 10,000 residents, compared to the national median of 0.47 (0.59 kindergartens per 10,000 residents; median 0.47).
best_for: Buyers looking for a mountainous environment with an elevation mean of 1,936 m.
Residents seeking higher than median healthcare and school provision per capita.
watch_out: Price data is completely missing, and listings sample size is only 2.
